name: mgp
description: mgp (formerly Rekam): render HTML compositions (mgp.motion timelines, canvas, CSS; HyperFrames-compatible composition format) to MP4/ProRes/PNG frame by frame, locally with Chrome/Edge + ffmpeg.

scripts.check-examples: node bin/mgp.mjs check examples/kinetic-9x16.html && node bin/mgp.mjs check examples/canvas-seek.html && node bin/mgp.mjs check examples/compat/index.html
